prompts.name: inbox-light
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity desktop screenshot of KasiTek Growth, a real business application. One complete flat front-facing browser viewport, landscape 1600x1000-ish, no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective. Match the supplied reference's precise typography and quiet Attio/Twenty-inspired product design, but improve its density and remove instructional subtext. LIGHT theme only. Geist-like typography 13px body, 20px page heading, 11px muted labels, crisp fine Phosphor-style regular outline UI icons. White canvas #FFFFFF, faint gray sidebar #F7F8F9, hairline #E8EAED separators, dark #191B1F text, secondary #62686F, restrained blue #2569D2 selection/action. No purple, gradients, glows, cartoon robots, oversized illustrations, KPI cards or marketing copy. Mostly flat rows, small 6px corners, restrained badges. All text legible and carefully spaced.

SHARED SHELL, identical across the three screens: 220px left sidebar; top left small black rounded-square K mark and word Growth, a workspace switcher 'KasiTek' below. Compact quick search. Sidebar groups: Home (Overview, Agents), Customer (Inbox, Calls, Contacts, Bookings), Content (Posts, Calendar, Analytics), Campaigns (Campaigns, Templates), Manage (Connections). Settings and Enock avatar at bottom. Neutral fine outline icons 16px, muted section labels, selected item faint blue. 52px top bar across content has breadcrumb at left, small search, notifications, avatar at right. Do not copy the reference's Agents-only sidebar or unsupported tool catalogue. This is Growth, with product-specific workflows. Use realistic illustrative South African business data. Design proposal, not a claim of shipped integration support.
SCREEN: Inbox selected in navigation. A polished tri-pane shared customer inbox. Main title Inbox in top bar. Below toolbar, narrow 290px conversation list, central conversation about 600px, right customer details about 250px; keep the complete page visible. Conversation list header 'Inbox' with subtle count 12, search icon, filter icon. Small tabs 'Open 12', 'Assigned to me 4', 'Closed'. Compact channel filter 'All channels'. Rows with initial avatars, names, 1-line previews, time, tiny channel brand icon and unread blue dot. Names Thandi Mokoena, Sipho Dlamini, Naledi Jacobs, Kabelo Molefe, Priya Naidoo. Select Thandi, soft gray row. Preview 'Can I move my appointment to Friday?'. Header in central pane shows Thandi Mokoena and WhatsApp · +27 82 555 0142. Right actions assign to Enock, more menu, 'Close'. Date separator 'Today'. Real chat: customer 'Hi, can I move my appointment to Friday?'; staff 'Hi Thandi. What time works best for you?'; customer 'Around 10 am, if that’s available.' Small unobtrusive delivery timestamps. Simple outgoing pale-blue bubbles and incoming white fine-border bubbles, no excessive decoration. Bottom composer with Reply selector, attachment icon, textarea placeholder 'Reply to Thandi…', blue Send button. Right sidebar 'Contact' with avatar, name, email thandi@example.com, phone, organization 'Mokoena Studio', one small 'Customer' tag. Following simple 'Details' fields Owner Enock, Channel WhatsApp, Status Open. At bottom 'Recent activity' with two small timeline entries. No fake AI confidence scores, no analytics graphs, no explanatory paragraphs. Intentional comfortable density, elegant use of whitespace, all panes aligned.

Avoid MCP URLs, API schemas or skills in this Growth screen; it is connected communication and publishing accounts, not the Agents tool catalogue. No giant analytics panels or setup explanations.

SCREEN: Agents selected in navigation. Page title 'Agents', blue 'New conversation' upper right. Tabs 'Overview', 'Conversations', 'Activity', Overview selected with understated underline. Design the main hub with real Growth-owned defaults, avoiding duplicated customer-service agent creation. Four equal compact agent cards in a deliberate 2x2 grid, each about 440px wide and 138px high, thin borders, 6px radius. Each has a small neutral monochrome outline icon, name and short job line, an elegant 'Chat' button at bottom right and quiet ellipsis at top right. Cards: 'Growth assistant' / 'Business context and everyday work'; 'Research' / 'Research your business sources'; 'Content' / 'Draft and improve content'; 'Campaigns' / 'Review campaign performance'. No made-up agent metrics, bright robot avatars, configuration version labels or vanity stats.
Below, flat 'Recent conversations' table with columns Conversation, Agent, Updated and row chevrons. Rows: 'Plan this week’s priorities' / Growth assistant / 12 min ago; 'Compare our customer segments' / Research / Yesterday; 'Draft the weekend offer' / Content / Yesterday; 'Review the April campaign' / Campaigns / 2 days ago. Small simple lineicons, maybe 4rows. A quiet section 'Activity' below lists 'Weekend offer' with small 'Needs review' amber badge and Content agent at left, plus 'Open' at right. Keep it visually simple.
On the right, a 360px assistant drawer OPEN over the hub without dark overlay, separated by fine vertical line. Header 'Growth assistant', expand and close icons. Small recent exchange: user 'Help me plan this week.'; assistant 'Let’s start with your priorities. What would you like to focus on?' Neutral readable chat no massivecolored bubbles. At bottom composer 'Message your agent…', small attach-context icon, a model selector 'NVIDIA Nemotron' and send arrow. Header's right edge drawer not obscure buttons. This drawer is the existing general assistant quick access, same conversation as full Agents view; make visual continuity obvious with matching header. No duplicated second floating launcher while drawer open. Intentional clean spacing, calm information density.
